definition.zh-TW: 資本支出占營業收入的比例，看公司為了做生意要投入多少在設備上。數值越高表示越重資產。
definition.en: Capital expenditure as a share of revenue: how much has to be invested in equipment to support the business. Higher means a more asset-heavy business.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
